interface.signature: canMeasureWater(x: int, y: int, z: int) -> bool

preconditions.description: The capacities and the target amount must be non-negative integers.
At least one jug must have a non-zero capacity.

postconditions.expression: result == (z == 0 or (z <= x + y and z % gcd(x, y) == 0))
postconditions.description: The result is true if and only if it is possible to measure exactly z liters using the two jugs with capacities x and y.
